Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Every 3 to 6 months for the first 3 years after primary therapy, every 6 to 12 months for the next 2 years, and annually thereafter
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: A detailed cancer-related history and physical examination should be conducted regularly to monitor for recurrence and manage any ongoing symptoms or side effects.
Annual mammography is recommended for the intact breast to monitor for new primary breast cancer.
